newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran says to import five mln T wheat to March 98.
newsitem.headline: Iran says to import five mln T wheat to March 98.

text.p: Iran will need to import five million tonnes of wheat in the year to March 21, 1998, a senior official said in remarks published on Wednesday.

Mahmoud Karimi-Nouri, head of the state Cereal Organisation, said the five million tonnes of imports were in addition to five million tonnes which the government would buy from local producers in the current Iranian year that ends on March 21, 1998, the Tehran daily Salam reported.

Karimi-Nouri said the government would pay a total of six trillion rials ($2 billion) for the wheat purchases, the newspaper said. The wheat is sold at subsidised prices to bakeries to keep bread prices low.
He said the government bought 4.4 million tonnes of wheat from local producers and imported another five million tonnes in the Iranian year that ended on March 20.

Bread is a main staple of the Iranian diet and among commodities for which the government has budgeted to pay $1.4 billion in subsidies in the current year. ($1=3,000 rials at the official exchange rate) FS cmd
